purpose: Secondary descriptive diagnostics, separate from the predeclared fixed-input prediction and tracking gate.
notes: Predictions on different controller trajectories are not a common-input comparison; within each trajectory both predictors read the same native states and requested input.
Zero-trajectory nominal error is close to floating-point scale, so large ratios are not physical failure probabilities.
Full-time ground-force peaks include the paid initial prefix. Contact distance includes self-contact; these developer thresholds do not certify hardware safety.
Fixed PD is one declared gain choice, not a tuned strong classical baseline.
The stated gate belongs to the supplied audit; this report covers only the explicitly listed archive inputs.
